title: Imported Defaults
description: A shipment that entered the system via a bulk CSV upload is still a normal shipment underneath — it should carry the same fresh, unremarkable defaults as one a customer booked by hand.
successCondition: Import a single valid row via POST /api/admin/shipments/import. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the resulting shipment confirms status = 'booked', approved = true, and currency = 'USD' — the exact same defaults a normal POST /api/booking shipment gets, even though this row never went through the booking wizard.
hints: The import path calls prisma.shipment.create with the same underlying model as booking (apps/api/src/modules/admin/service.ts) — Prisma's column defaults apply identically regardless of which route created the row.
Required CSV columns and formatting are documented in docs/api/admin.md.
